# Marisol

A major retrospective of Marisol, icon of pop art. Behind her appealing and humorous work lies a sharp message about the role of women, societal norms, and the way we deal with climate.

[Tickets](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/tickets "Tickets") [More info ](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/exhibitions/marisol "More info")

![](https://static.boijmans.nl/dist/assets/img/lazy/placeholder-1240x700.png)

Depot

### Go Behind the Scenes at the Depot

Ever wondered what a museum keeps out of sight? Bring your group on a guided tour of the Depot and step inside the world’s first publicly accessible art storage facility. You’ll explore the building and see artworks up close in the storage compartments, a view you won’t get anywhere else.

[Tickets ](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/tickets "Tickets") [More info ](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/activities/guided-tour "More info")

![](https://static.boijmans.nl/dist/assets/img/lazy/placeholder-1240x700.png)

Depot

### Restaurant Renilde

On the sixth floor of the Depot of Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, high above Rotterdam, you will find Renilde. We serve a menu that changes daily, shaped by the best the season has to offer. Exciting flavours, carefully prepared and shaped by the best seasonal produce.

[Tickets ](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/tickets-depot-renilde?_gl=1*1yqjo4h*_up*MQ..&gclid=EAIaIQobChMI_rS_idTbkwMVe5qDBx0-yidnEAAYASAAEgJrZPD_BwE "Tickets")

[In memory of our director Ina Klaassen Sunday 11 October 2026 It is with great sadness that we announce the death of our director Ina Klaassen (1969 – 2026) following an illness.
